meta_description: AK Plastering Services in Manchester offers expert plastering, skimming, and rendering. Free quotes, fast turnaround, local family business. Call 07943 072328.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Free Quotes, No Hidden Fees
hero_subhead: From damp patch repairs to full room skimming, AK Plastering gets the job done right first time. Call today for a free quote.
services_subhead: Whether it's a small repair, full decoration, or commercial project, we handle all plastering work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, perfectly finished walls and ceilings ready for decoration. We work fast without compromising quality, leaving your home ready to paint.

services.title: Damp & Water Damage Repairs
services.desc: Specialist repair of water-damaged plaster and damp patches. We identify the cause, treat it, and replaster to prevent future problems.

services.title: Rendering & External Plastering
services.desc: Durable external renders protect your home from the elements. We use weather-resistant finishes built to last in Manchester's climate.

services.title: Artex Removal & Re-plastering
services.desc: Safe removal of old Artex ceiling and replacement with smooth modern finishes. Quicker and cleaner than you'd expect.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Projects
services.desc: Large-scale plastering for offices, shops, and industrial units. We work around your schedule to minimise disruption.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Touch-Ups
services.desc: Small holes, cracks, or patchy areas sorted quickly. We match existing finishes perfectly so repairs blend in seamlessly.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd be happy to have done in my own home.
about_para_1: AK Plastering Services was founded on a simple principle: provide honest, skilled plastering at a fair price. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation across Manchester for turning shabby walls into beautifully finished surfaces. Our team specialises in everything from interior skimming to external rendering, and we take pride in leaving every job cleaner and tidier than we found it.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we show up on time, do what we say we'll do, and stand behind our work. We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or hidden charges—just straightforward pricing and quality craftsmanship. Whether you're a homeowner refreshing a bedroom or a property manager overseeing multiple renovations, you can rely on AK to deliver.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a large damp patch on our bedroom wall that needed sorting before we could decorate. Arif came out, assessed it properly, and replastered the whole wall. Looks immaculate now. Really helpful bloke, fair price, would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called AK on a Monday morning for a quote on removing Artex from our lounge ceiling. Arif was round by Wednesday and the work was done by Friday. Really impressed with how clean he kept the place and the finish is brilliant. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: We're a small café in Stockport and needed the walls replastered and painted before reopening. AK worked evenings and managed not to disrupt our daytime trade. Professional, reliable, and they didn't cut corners. Will be using them again for our next location.
reviews.author: David L.
